title: ClearPath Coverage and the Share of the Microsoft 365 Administration Fee Charged
content:
**Coverage clause.** Where a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) plan is marked in the administration fee schedule as subject to waiver while the client's ClearPath agreement covers Microsoft 365 administration, the share of Stratton Bay's license administration fee charged follows the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services coverage. The coverage is taken as it stands on the day the fee posts, which Stratton Bay takes for the month just ended.

- **No fee.** The client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active or notice given, and whose tier includes Microsoft 365 administration. No fee is posted: the share charged is **0 percent**.
- **Half the fee.** The client holds an active ClearPath Monitor agreement, whose tier does not include Microsoft 365 administration. Half the fee is charged: **50 percent**.
- **No reduction.** Any other client, and every client on a plan not marked as subject to that waiver, has no reduction of the share charged.

The status, the tier and whether the tier covers Microsoft 365 tenant administration (user, mailbox and license changes) are read from the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement record.

## Decision table

| Plan's fee subject to the ClearPath waiver | ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement on the posting day | Share of the fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| yes | active, tier includes Microsoft 365 administration | 0 percent, no fee posted |
| yes | notice given, tier includes Microsoft 365 administration | 0 percent, no fee posted |
| yes | active ClearPath Monitor | 50 percent |
| yes | any other agreement, or none | no reduction |
| no | any | no reduction |

## Points of judgement

- Coverage is read on the posting day. An agreement that becomes active before the fee posts counts for the month just ended.
- Example with a hypothetical fee of 60.00 USD: an active ClearPath Monitor client is charged 30.00, and a covered client is charged nothing.
